transport: wasm-bindgen typed JS wrapper; lightweight events; no WebSocket or server API

ownership.react: presentation state (panels, theme, search query, loading UI)
ownership.rust: scene, camera, selected ID, visibility, GPU buffers, asset scheduler

types.AnatomyId: ta2:<code>[:left|:right]; concrete published catalog is authority
types.RegionId: string from manifest; not arbitrary URLs
types.VariantId: male-adult | female-adult, restricted to those published
types.RequestId: monotonically increasing uint32 or UUID (stable per request)
types.SceneGeneration: monotonically increasing int per scene-load intent
types.SceneSnapshot: {region, variant, selectedId?, sceneRevision, visibleIds, quality, backend}; immutable versioned snapshot

api.name: initialize
api.preconditions: canvas present and no previous active instance

invariants: selectedId is AnatomyId, never node index
all async completions carry requestId and sceneGeneration
late load result cannot mutate newer generation
region.ready after base geometry is actually renderable
React must not mirror thousands of mesh transforms
wasm API does not expose GPU object handles
no force-retry loop on unrecoverable WebGPU/WebGL2 errors
when backend switch requires canvas reinitialization, old canvas is disposed and a new canvas created
events carry bounded payloads and errors redact implementation details
designNotes: One shared Rust core; two small WASM bundles for reproducible WebGPU/WebGL2 support in the first milestone.
Do not choose backend based only on navigator.gpu; prove adapter, device, pipeline, and surface.
Event payload structure to be generated from a canonical schema/type definition during implementation, not manually duplicated.
setOpacity is intentionally deferred until transparent-pass acceptance; it is not a promised MVP API.
SceneSnapshot.visibleIds is on-demand only, not an event field emitted every frame.
